item.title: About
item.description: About Me I just graduated with a MSc in Mathematics and Foundations of Computer Science with a Distinction and 81% overall. I hold a First Class Honours from the University of Edinburgh as well. During my time at Edinburgh, I served as the Vice-President of TypeSIG - the university’s only CS theory-focused student society. Theory underpins innovation, it balances nuance and rigour with wonder and beauty. Outreach in theoretical computer science means a lot to me.
